hypotheses_queue.observation: Error taxonomy on public benchmark shows 73.0% of misses are typo_heavy_name_address where word-level overlap collapses under OCR/phonetic noise.
hypotheses_queue.hypothesis: Adding sublinear character 3-5 gram TF-IDF cosine alongside word TF-IDF provides an out-of-vocabulary fallback that recovers severe typos without causing false merges.
hypotheses_queue.falsification_test: Measure held-out test recall and verify that false merges remain 0 while typo_heavy misses are reduced.

hypotheses_queue.observation: Optimal threshold on validation (0.15) achieves 95.07% on test, but singleton detection threshold can be dynamically adjusted based on candidate probability gap.
hypotheses_queue.hypothesis: Enforcing a minimum confidence margin between top candidate and second candidate for 1-to-many acceptance will prevent drift on ambiguous borderline cases.
hypotheses_queue.falsification_test: Check if validation F0.5 improves or stays strictly >= 0.9507.

history.finding: F0.5 jump from 0.84 to 0.91 was caused by silent .replace() bug leaking identical addresses, not parser.
Auditing all generator .replace() calls established genuine adversarial baseline at 0.8644.
Generalized trailing number regex recovered 18 abbreviated French street numbers, lifting F0.5 to 0.9167.
Unicode NFKD accent stripping + dotted initial collapse + international legal forms boosted F0.5 to 0.9233.

Evaluated on independent 10,000-record public FEBRL4 benchmark without cheat IDs: achieved 0.9507 Macro F0.5, 95.07% Precision, 95.07% Recall, and 0 False Merges. Extreme negative separability confirmed (all 337k non-matches P < 0.20).
